subject: Clearview POC — extension & close incentive proposal
messages:
From: Asha Roy <asha@clearview.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick ask — short extension + credits to finish POC

Hi Sergio,

Thanks again for the help this week — the team is close but hit an integration blocker that pushed our timeline out ~10 days. We have an exec review next Friday and need a bit more runway to show the full integration and latency numbers.

Two asks: would Redwood consider
- a two-week trial extension for our Clearview POC, and
- a small one-off credit package to cover burst inference during the final tests (estimate: 200k tokens)?

If you can share what approval looks like today I can fast-track exec sign-off. Attaching a short usage snapshot.

Best,
Asha Roy
Head of Applied AI, Clearview Analytics
Attachments: Clearview_usage_snapshot.csv (CSV)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Quick ask — short extension + credits to finish POC

Looping you in — Clearview is asking for a 2-week extension + credits to close. They’re at a decision point on 12/24 and the POC outcome drives conversion. Usage attached shows heavier spikes near the end.

What’s our standard close incentive for a late-stage POC like this? TL;DR: they need predictable burst capacity for final tests and an extension window. Can we do a 2-week extension + a $2k credit earmarked for burst tokens without setting precedent?

Background: account team thinks this converts to a dedicated deployment if successful. Deal id: DL-2027-1187.

Thanks — Sergio
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2027 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick ask — short extension + credits to finish POC

Sergio — thanks. Approve the ask in principle: 2 week extension + $2,000 platform credit earmarked to the Clearview account for usage during the extension. A few constraints:
- Credit must be one-off (no recurring pricing change),
- Extension is non-billable for the extension window only,
- Legal needs to sign off on the customer-facing language in the MLA addendum.

Monica, can you prepare an addendum draft and the DocuSign link? Lauren, please flag any margin concerns.

Ben
VP Sales Operations

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Dec 2027 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick ask — short extension + credits to finish POC

On it — I drafted a short addendum that outlines: extension dates (12/20/2027–01/03/2028), one-off $2,000 credit applied to token usage during the extension, and the requirement that the customer signs the addendum and confirms no other contractual concessions. I uploaded the PDF with redlines: Clearview_MLA_redlines.pdf

DocuSign link will be ready by EOD — recommended subject line: "Redwood — POC extension & one-off credit (Clearview)".

Flag: procurement sometimes asks for language about audit logs/retention when credits are involved — Ben, do we need to pre-empt that?

— Monica
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Asha Roy <asha@clearview.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, procurement@clearview.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Clearview POC — extension & one-off credit approved

Hi Asha — great to connect. Quick update from our side: we can approve a two-week extension and a one-time $2,000 credit to be applied to Clearview's account for burst inference during the extension window.

Summary:
- Extension window: 2027-12-20 through 2028-01-03 (non-billable period for standard plan charges)
- One-time credit: $2,000 applied to token consumption during the extension only
- Condition: customer must sign the addendum and confirm no additional concessions are requested

Monica has uploaded the addendum and will send a DocuSign link momentarily (Clearview_MLA_redlines.pdf). Once signed, we’ll apply the credit and enable the extension.

Asha — please confirm you can sign and we’ll queue the DocuSign. If procurement needs a single point of contact for audit questions, loop them in and Monica will respond.

Thanks and happy holidays if we miss you next week — let’s get this across the line.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
